item.title: An alternative path for artificial intelligence in Africa
item.content:encoded:
Nature Computational Science, Published online: 19 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01084-9

African governments face a perceived choice between investing in costly national data centers and dependence on foreign technology providers. Both options rest on assumptions that the evidence no longer supports. We argue for a third path, distributed sovereignty: cooperative infrastructure designed for African conditions.

item.title: Generative molecular design needs oracle grounding
item.content:encoded:
Nature Computational Science, Published online: 19 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01082-x

Generative molecular design is guided by oracles, computational proxies of experimental goals that models can exploit. We argue that oracle grounding, in which experiments diagnose and correct oracle failures, will allow generative models to discover not only new molecules but also new chemistry.
item.dc:title: Generative molecular design needs oracle grounding
item.dc:creator: Sarina Kopf
Philippe Schwaller
